We completely understand your concern and appreciate your understanding. Please note that the revised rate has been updated as per the management's decision and current market conditions, and unfortunately, this is beyond our control.

If you would like to proceed with the extension, please let us know, and we will be happy to assist you with the arrangements. Otherwise, kindly note that your check-out is scheduled for today.

Thank you, and we look forward to your confirmation.
